profile.headline: Full Stack Web Developer
profile.summary:
Software Developer with 5+ years of experience in back-end development. Experienced with all stages of the development cycle for dynamic web projects. Well-versed in numerous programming languages, including PHP frameworks,Java, JavaScript, SQL. Strong background in project management and customer relations.
Experience in the development of Server-side scripting based languages and frameworks. Handling development and deploying on production servers.Proven ability to leverage full-stack expertise to build interactive and user-centered website designs to scale. Moreover, Expertise in large system architecture development and administration,as well as network design, configuration,and software development lifecycle(SDLC).Project enhancements and bugs solving.Ensuring best practices, modularity, on-time delivery with quality.Define user Interface and Conceptual Navigation Prototypes.Managed,developed,and designed a dashboard control panel for customers and administrators using Oracle DB,MySQL and various RESTful API calls.Actively using Git,GitHub,GitLab,SVN,Bitbucket for software version control management.Efficiently deployed and integrated software engineered by the team and updated integration/deployment scripts to improve continuous deployment practices.
Exceptional ability to quickly master new concepts and frameworks.Ecommerce integration. Designed, implemented, and monitored websites especially in Magento for continuous improvement in a fast-paced environment.Magento2 development: Custom Module Development, Custom Theme Development, Core Module overriding, Shipping Carrier Integration, Payment Method integration, etc.Created site layout and user interface using HTML and CSS and JavaScript.Analyzed requirements and designed, developed, and implemented software applications for multiple websites.Completed full redesigns of existing websites to improve navigation, enhance visuals.
Created eye-catching and functional digital design concepts across various platforms to strengthen the company brand and identity.Created and maintained new websites to client specifications, working in close order with other developers as well as designers and client relations specialists to provide the optimal website for client needs.
Modified third-party extensions to improve their functionality with the existing Magento framework.
Fixing bugs from existing websites and implemented enhancements that significantly improved web functionality and speed.
Create a custom Api integration for mobile application.
